notes.title: New Product Festival & New Games
notes.content: [p]Dear players and friends,[/p][p][/p][p]Long time no see! We have been working hard to prepare a brand new visual novel game "Wandering Souls" for you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921646/feab550c6cad59da7e213fcec923fd7a706e7a68.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We took it to the New Product Festival today![/p][p]Although it is still an early version, this is a great opportunity for us to show you the core concept and initial appearance of the game. Players who like the suspense and slight horror in the legends of strange stories should not miss it. Welcome to the New Product Festival page:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456190/__Wandering_Souls_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: English localization update announcement
notes.content: Hello everyone, 《SECRET OPERA》 has now launched an English localized version. All text, dialogue and user interface in the game have been fully translated into English. We hope to establish a deeper cultural connection with players and provide a more personalized game experience.
